observations.humor_and_timing: Neet delegating first sky shift to asleep Buddy prepares his immediate retreat. Bring cheese/bring silence creates a compact collision of appetite and safety. Three careful kitchen steps with no progress, Buddy refusing to concede the floor, and the moving cheese-nose give distinct physical beats rather than interchangeable banter. The date bowl is the largest mishap; a tested landing and then morning check develop a consequence. Buddy squeak followed by the farther rumble is given a pause, allowing his claimed warning to land.
observations.voices_and_agency: Neet remains theatrical but frightened, then resumes courage from safety. Buddy acts on his own wants: cheese pursuit, chair refuge, attempted lap jump and learned bowl check. Sagar calm snack ritual contrasts with Heather exhausted amusement and practical reassurance. All four participate without reducing Buddy to commentary.
observations.cause_effect_pacing: Storm interrupts anticipated sleep, dogs follow Sagar for comfort and food, kitchen misadventures lead to the blanket retreat, tray/bowl repositioning enables the accident, reassurance and receding thunder allow sleep. Seven sections retain that chain, and illustrations occur after completed action or dialogue blocks.
observations.emotional_payoff: Heather reassuring both dogs and Buddy leaning against her ground the comedy in safety. Section VI has uninterrupted breathing room, and morning thanks and touch earn the affectionate ending before Buddy small visual callback.
observations.complementary_images: Five images cover sheltered close-up, elevated kitchen predicament, hidden cheese pursuit, bowl payoff, and quiet daylight learning. Viewpoints and exposed/covered poses vary; none is merely a repeated portrait.
